name: documents
purpose: Carry document staging, finalization, listing, transfer, removal, and backup projection through the generated API client without recreating policy.

directBrowserFlows.name: signed-document-upload
directBrowserFlows.scope: Upload exactly one staged object with the backend-issued signed transfer token.
directBrowserFlows.reviewCondition: The browser must not select a bucket, key, retention rule, lifecycle state, or additional object operation.

forbiddenResponsibilities: Document validation, lifecycle, reference, retention, integrity, authorization, or step-up policy
Direct documents-table queries or broad storage-bucket access
Handwritten transport DTOs or generated-client deep imports
